# Twenty provider

The provider authenticates a dedicated automation account with a password session. The `twenty_role` data source reads existing roles; the separate `twenty_role` resource manages custom roles and their complete explicit permission flag sets. It targets Twenty v2.44.0 and uses Metadata GraphQL at `/metadata`. No membership resources, object/field permission ownership, or CRM record operations are implemented.

See [custom roles](resources/role.md), [permissions](guides/permissions.md), and [import guidance](guides/import.md).

This provider is unreleased. Build it locally and use Terraform CLI `dev_overrides`; the Registry cannot install it yet.

## Example usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    twenty = {
      source = "glitchedmob/twenty"
    }
  }
}

# Unreleased. Build locally and use a Terraform CLI dev_overrides entry.
# Inject TWENTY_EMAIL and TWENTY_PASSWORD outside checked-in configuration.
provider "twenty" {
  endpoint = "https://twenty.example.com"
}
```

Inject `TWENTY_EMAIL` and `TWENTY_PASSWORD` through your secret-injection process. Do not put credentials in checked-in configuration. See the [authentication guide](guides/authentication.md) for sensitive ephemeral inputs and account requirements.

## Configuration behavior

`TWENTY_ENDPOINT`, `TWENTY_EMAIL`, and `TWENTY_PASSWORD` supply values for omitted or null attributes. Explicit values override the environment, including empty strings. An explicit empty value is an error, not a request to use the environment. Unknown attributes are errors at provider configuration time.

Endpoint and email whitespace is trimmed. Password bytes are preserved. All three values are required for an authenticated configuration; there is no default endpoint.

Use the instance HTTPS base URL without credentials, a path, query, fragment, or `/metadata` suffix. Redirects are rejected. For deliberate disposable local tests only, set `allow_insecure_http = true` and use `localhost` or a literal loopback IP address. This option has no environment fallback and never disables HTTPS certificate checks.

Each provider configuration starts a new session and validates the active workspace and authenticated member. Access and refresh tokens stay in provider-process memory. The provider serializes renewal and replaces both server-issued tokens. It does not persist sessions across runs.

Absent or raw-null provider configuration returns before reading credentials or making requests, so schema tools need no Twenty instance. An explicit empty provider block is an authenticated configuration and uses environment fallbacks.

## Authentication limits

The account must already exist, have verified email, support password sign-in, and belong to an active workspace. The provider cannot complete interactive MFA, CAPTCHA, or SSO-only sign-in. Do not weaken those controls or email verification on a live instance.

Keep the automation identity and its own role outside Terraform-managed membership and role resources. Preserve an independent recovery administrator. API keys and userless client credentials do not cover the intended membership operations in this Twenty release.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_insecure_http` (Boolean) Allow unencrypted HTTP only for deliberate local testing with localhost or a literal loopback IP address. Defaults to false. No environment fallback. HTTPS certificate verification is never disabled.
- `email` (String) Dedicated verified automation account email for password-session authentication. Must be one bare ASCII mailbox address without a display name, comments, or control characters. Surrounding spaces are trimmed. May also be set with `TWENTY_EMAIL`. Explicit values, including empty values, override the environment. MFA and CAPTCHA flows are not supported.
- `endpoint` (String) Twenty instance HTTPS base URL, without the `/metadata` suffix, credentials, other paths, query, or fragment. May also be set with `TWENTY_ENDPOINT`. No default. Explicit values, including empty values, override the environment. Redirects are rejected.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Automation account password for a new in-memory session on each provider configuration. May also be set with `TWENTY_PASSWORD`. Explicit values, including empty values, override the environment. Sensitive values can still appear in saved Terraform plans; inject credentials through the environment.
